rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a person who lives apart from society, without specifically stressing religion.

example.english: After retiring, he became a hermit in the mountains and hardly interacted with anyone for years.
example.traditional: 佢退休之後搬去山入面做隱士，幾年都唔同人來往。
example.jyutping: keoi5 teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6 bun1 heoi3 saan1 jap6 min6 zou6 jan2 si6 gei2 nin4 dou1 m4 tung4 jan4 loi4 wong5

rows.jyutping: lei4 kwan4 sok3 geoi1 ge3 jan4
rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the person deliberately avoids human contact, rather than simply living alone.

example.english: That hermit in the village always keeps his door shut and refuses to see people.
example.traditional: 村入面嗰個離群索居嘅人，成日閂埋道門，唔肯見人。
example.jyutping: cyun1 jap6 min6 go2 go3 lei4 kwan4 sok3 geoi1 ge3 jan4 seng4 jat6 saan1 maai4 dou6 mun4 m4 hang2 gin3 jan4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a religious hermit who withdraws from society for spiritual reasons.

example.english: This religious hermit lives alone near the monastery and prays every day.
example.traditional: 呢位隱修士喺修院附近獨居，每日祈禱。
example.jyutping: nei1 wai6 jan2 sau1 si6 hai2 sau1 jyun2 fu6 gan6 duk6 geoi1 mui5 jat6 kei4 tou2
